practices.title: Evidence Integrity
practices.failure_mode: An unchecked evidence-integrity property can mislead a review.
practices.remedy: Correct the fixture and rerun the local check.
practices.negative_case: A planted evidence-integrity violation must fail.
practices.definition: Evidence text has a source, subject revision and matching SHA-256 digest.

practices.title: Bounded Work
practices.failure_mode: An unchecked bounded-work property can mislead a review.
practices.remedy: Correct the fixture and rerun the local check.
practices.negative_case: A planted bounded-work violation must fail.
practices.definition: Recorded steps stay within the positive declared maximum.

practices.definition: Requested actions are contained in the separately trusted allowed action set.
